task.text:
[0] C57Bl/6 mice with ERCC1 knockout had a maximal lifespan of 38 days.

[1] C57Bl/6-background mice with carboxy-terminal truncation of ERCC1 gene (lacking last 7 aminoacids) had a maximal lifespan of 78 days.

[2] Ercc-1 mutation (deletion of Rad10 domain) further extends, rather than decreases, the life span of long-lived daf-2 (IGF1R) knockout worms, likely through an adaptive activation of stress signaling.

[3] Mice, expressing ERCC1 version lacking 7 carboxyterminal aminoacids, had a shorter lifespan, compromised growth and organ weights, and symptoms of accelerated aging.

[4] Mice, expressing ERCC1 version lacking 7 carboxyterminal aminoacids, had a shorter lifespan, compromised growth and organ weights, and symptoms of accelerated aging.

[5] Ercc-1 mutation (deletion of Rad10 domain) didn't affect the lifespan of worms significantly.

[6] Xpd (ERCC2) m/m mice exhibited increased mutation burden in liver and kidney, and reduced lifespan.

[7] Female mice, homozygous by R722W mutation in Xpd (ERCC2), had progeroid features, signs of a caloric restriction though been fed ad libitum, and shortened lifespan.

[8] Trichothiodystrophy model mice (XPD-null) with additional XPA knockout failed to grow after 2 weeks old, exhibited cachexia, and died at an extremely young age.

[9] Xpf-1 (e1487) mutation further extend, rather than decrease, the life span of long-lived daf-2 animals likely through an adaptive activation of stress signaling.

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.

Passages [3] and [4] are identical in content, so both were scored identically.
